subject: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan

Team —

Quick heads-up: finance flagged a coverage shortfall for Q4 in today’s forecast run. Attached is a first-pass snapshot (Q4_pipe_snapshot_v1.xlsx) that shows current pipe-to-quota at ~2.1x on plan, our target is 3.2x by close. I need a quick triage so we have a concrete commit plan by EOD Friday.

Asks (please):
- Update stage for any deals that have moved in the last 7 days in HubSpot (change close dates / stage as needed).
- Mark any deals you consider committed with the tag "Commit-Q4" and add one-sentence justification on the deal note.
- If a deal is at risk of slipping out of Q4, update the expected close month and reason.
- If you have any quick actions (accelerate POC, procurement call, discount approval), note owner and ETA.

I’ll consolidate and work with finance on coverage reforecast. Ava — can you attach the cleaned snapshot you ran yesterday and point to the master Drive folder? Ben — if you can confirm the coverage target and minimum acceptable runway assumptions, that helps.

I’ve looped in Amir at Acme (external) — Aditya please confirm status on that trial and whether Amir is ready to commit by 12/20.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[hannah_schmitt@redwood.com]

-----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads-up: finance flagged a coverage shortfall for Q4 in today’s forecast run. Attached is a first-pass snapshot...

Thanks Hannah — quick color from my side on the biggest items:
- ACME-Analytics (Amir) is on a 2-week extended trial after the POC; product asked for one more integration slice (ETA 12/10). I have an exec sponsor engaged but Amir has not committed to a purchase order yet. I put it as "best-case" in the sheet.
- Two deals (OLIVE-INT, OLIVE-PRO) were marked In Review last week but legal requested privacy language; those likely slip into Jan if we don’t expedite the contract review.

Questions:
1) Do we want AEs to move best-case deals into "Commit" if they have strong exec verbal? (That affects coverage math vs the sales reality).
2) Can we get a one-off fast-track legal review for Olive deals if we push a specific ask?

I’ll update the Acme deal note with the integration checklist and estimate. Aditya
Sr Account Executive | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan

Attached: coverage_gap_calc.csv, and I pushed a cleaned snapshot to the Drive folder (link below).

Quick notes:
- I reconciled closed-won/closed-lost through 12/02 and removed three late-stage churns we previously left in the plan (they were marked FW and mis-tagged). That reduced best-case by $420k.
- I flagged 7 deals that have had no activity in >21 days; recommend AE outreach ASAP or de-dup into "stale" pipeline.
- HubSpot tag guidance: please use "Commit-Q4" only for legal-signed/PO'd or leadership-approved verbal. Do not use commit for verbal exec only.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ4_pipe_review

Ava Chen
Sales Operations Analyst | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan

Team —

Confirmed: coverage target for Q4 is 3.2x quota (we're modeling downside scenarios with 2.4x min runway). Numbers matter here because board reporting will reference the conservative case. If we treat verbal as commit we inflate coverage artificially and we risk a miss in the conservative model.

Options to close the gap (short list):
- Reallocate two SDRs for 2 weeks to focus on top-50 best-fit accounts that are in late-stage trials (expected uplift ~ $600k if we convert 25%).
- Fast-track contract/legal on 2 deals: Olive-PRO and Olive-INT. We can ask Legal for a priority review; need Diego/AE sponsorship.
- Push a selective discounts play (up to 10%) for deals that sign within Q4. Finance needs deal-level approval for >7% discount.

If we cannot get the conservative commits to 2.4x coverage, we should prepare contingency asks for Exec (marketing acceleration budget / recognition of seasonality).

Happy to run the reforecast once you hand me committed/commit-tagged deals. Ben
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan

Following up with actions from the floor: 
- I confirmed two deals will move to Commit-Q4: ACME-Analytics (pending final PO; AE to secure PO by 12/17) and MERCURY-TECH (leadership verbal + invoice requested). Added deal notes and committed amounts in the sheet.
- I asked Legal to prioritize Olive contracts; we have a legal request number (REQ-7782). If Legal can clear one by 12/14 we can salvage the pipeline.
- Approving SDR reallocation pilot — we’ll assign SDRs to focus on top-30 accounts starting Monday.

Aditya: please confirm any specific contract ask for Acme (billing terms / SOW scope). Ava: I updated the master snapshot with Diego's commit adjustments.

Diego Fernandez
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, amir@acme-analytics.com, sara@olive-systems.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage shortfall triage & commit action plan — consolidated next steps

Thanks everyone — consolidated plan below (please read and ACK in thread):

1) HubSpot hygiene (owner: ALL AE owners) — by EOD Monday 12/07
   - Update close months and move stale deals to "stale-pipeline" if no activity in >21 days.
   - Tag legally-signed/PO'd deals with Commit-Q4 only.
2) Fast-track legal (owner: Diego / AEs) — request #REQ-7782 for Olive. Target: Legal decision by 12/14.
3) SDR reallocation (owner: Diego) — SDRs assigned to top-30 trial accounts starting 12/07.
4) Acme ask (owner: Aditya) — secure PO or clear procurement blockers by 12/17; update HubSpot with PO file.
5) Finance reforecast (owner: Ben) — run conservative model after Commit-Q4 tags are applied; target refresh 12/18.
6) Final consolidated snapshot (owner: Ava) — produce final_commit_updates.xlsx and share Drive + HubSpot links by 12/19.

If any owner cannot hit the date, post a quick reply with the blocker and new ETA. I’ll take the roll-up once we have the Commit-Q4 set. Ben — expect the packet for conservative coverage run on 12/18.

Attachments: final_commit_updates.xlsx (will be populated by Ava).

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

-----

Summary of tags applied in sheet (as of this email):
- Commit-Q4: ACME-Analytics ($420k tentative), MERCURY-TECH ($180k)
- Stale-suggested: 7 deals totaling ~$330k
- Legal fast-track: Olive-PRO, Olive-INT

Please ACK and update HubSpot.

--End of thread--
